data.exact_reserve_text: The estimate for claims at the beginning of the year as compared with net payments and provisions at the end of the year in respect of prior years' claims are as follows: Favourable movement in technical provisions 56.4. The movement in estimate of the prior year is driven mainly by favourable loss experience and incurred claims forms a 10% (2020: 7%) component of the 2021 loss ratio of 46% (2020: 53%).
data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate experienced a gross strengthening of GBP 8.1m in prior year reserves, representing approximately 1.0% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This movement is derived from the gross claims development triangle for underwriting years 2016-2019. While the report's narrative on page 12 mentions a net favourable movement of GBP 56.4m driven by "favourable loss experience", the gross calculation indicates a net strengthening across older years. No specific named events were identified as causes for this movement.
raw_causal_phrases: Positive result reflecting harder rating conditions, and low attritional and catastrophe loss experience.

Should the provisions prove to be different from the original estimate, adjustments are made to the claims provisions in respect of prior years and are included in the Technical account within the financial statements of the period when such adjustments are made.

Although the claims provision is considered to be reasonable, having regard to previous claims experience (including the use of certain statistically based projections) and case by case reviews of notified losses, on the basis of information available at the date of determining the provision, the ultimate liabilities will vary as a result of subsequent information and events. These adjustments are reflected in the financial statements for the period in which the related adjustments are made. There have been no changes in assumptions used to measure insurance assets and insurance liabilities during the year.
The movement in estimate of the prior year is driven mainly by favourable loss experience and incurred claims forms a 10% (2020: 7%) component of the 2021 loss ratio of 46% (2020: 53%).
Other technical income, net of reinsurance, includes reinsurance commissions and profit participation income of GBP 13.2m (2020: GBP 12.2m).

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The gross prior year development figure was calculated from the 'Gross reserves and payments' claims development triangle on page 14, as no explicit gross prior year movement figure was provided. This contrasts with the narrative on page 12 which states a net favourable movement of GBP 56.4m. LOB-specific prior year movements are only available on a net basis.
